fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-08-19 at approximately 09:20, it was reported that the complainant reported that a shop near Vaigai Layout Market Road was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. Contact details given by the complainant, Thirumal Babu, include the number 9000000321. The complaint mentions Bharath Selvam, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000273, in connection with the events. The complaint refers to Mathan Raman, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000187. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, suspect, market road, morning, documents, mobile number, associate
